jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Avenrix Services is hiring a Backend Engineer to work on an active enterprise client project involving backend services, data processing, search, and AI-assisted workflows.

The role is primarily focused on **Node.js/TypeScript development, PostgreSQL, APIs, data synchronization, production troubleshooting, and reliability**.

You’ll work with an existing production system and collaborate with engineers across backend, data, search, and AI-related areas.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain backend services using **Node.js and TypeScript**
* Build and maintain REST APIs and backend integrations
* Work with **PostgreSQL and SQL**
* Debug database queries and backend performance issues
* Support ETL, data pipelines, and synchronization between systems
* Investigate data inconsistencies, failed jobs, and production issues
* Help improve application reliability and data consistency
* Work with AWS-based services and environments
* Write automated tests and participate in code reviews
* Use logs, metrics, and tracing to troubleshoot issues
* Collaborate with engineers working on search, data, and AI-related functionality
* Participate in technical meetings and provide clear updates on your work, blockers, and technical decisions

**Required Skills**

* **2+ years of professional software development experience** or equivalent strong practical experience
* Good experience with **JavaScript / TypeScript**
* Backend development experience with **Node.js**
* Good knowledge of **SQL and relational databases**
* Experience with **PostgreSQL** or a similar database
* Experience developing or integrating REST APIs
* Familiarity with Git and standard development workflows
* Good debugging and problem-solving skills
* Ability to understand and work within an existing codebase
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks
* Good written and spoken English for technical communication
* Reliable, receptive to feedback, and willing to learn unfamiliar technologies

**Preferred Skills**

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

* AWS
* ETL or data pipelines
* Kafka or other event/messaging systems
* OpenTelemetry
* Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or similar observability tools
* OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
* Docker
* Python
* GitHub Actions or other CI/CD tools
* Distributed systems
* RAG / LLM applications
* AI or data-science workflows

**AI-Assisted Development**

Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools is welcome.

Candidates should still be able to understand, test, debug, and clearly explain the code they submit.

**What We Value**

We’re looking for someone who:

* Takes responsibility for their work
* Learns quickly
* Is comfortable receiving technical feedback
* Communicates problems and blockers clearly
* Investigates issues instead of guessing
* Can explain why they chose a particular implementation
* Is willing to suggest improvements when they see a better approach

**About Avenrix Services**

Avenrix Services supports businesses through project-based engineering and technology delivery across software, data, cloud, and AI-related initiatives.

For this engagement, you’ll contribute to an active enterprise technology project while working with engineering and project leadership.

Pay: $16.00-$24.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Citco**

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 80 offices worldwide. With more than $1 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

**About the Team & Business Line**

Proprietary software solutions and innovation are at the core of what differentiates Citco in the alternative investment space. Through our network of global development centres, Citco invests heavily in technology development, security, and infrastructure to ensure our clients continue to receive award-winning products that underpin our commitment to service excellence.

As a core member of our technology team, you will work with dedicated professionals to build and support secure, cloud-native, AI-enabled applications for the financial services industry. Using modern software engineering practices, AI-assisted development, and cross-functional collaboration, you will help deliver reliable, high-quality solutions that ensure clients maintain seamless access to their critical information assets while keeping Citco ahead of industry innovation.

Within the AI Engineering team, you will assist with developing document intelligence solutions that classify financial and client documents, extract structured data, and drive business process automation. Working closely with business stakeholders, you will contribute to the development, testing and enhancement of AI-powered solutions under the guidance of senior engineers leveraging large language models, natural language processing, document processing services, machine learning, and agentic workflows to solve complex business challenges and create measurable value.

  

**Your Role**

* You will work in a cross-functional agile team to build and support cloud-native and AI-enabled applications. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will deliver well-defined features, strengthen your software engineering skills and use AI development tools responsibly.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily scrums, reviews and retrospectives.
* Implement well-defined application features, APIs, data-processing components, prompts and AI integrations under guidance.
* Implement solutions based on established architecture, design patterns and technical specifications.
* Support the development of document-processing, machine-learning, RAG and generative AI capabilities.
* Write clean, typed and maintainable Python code, and contribute to ReactJS components where required.
* Work with common Python data and AI libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn under guidance.
* Create and validate unit and integration tests for changed behavior, including appropriate error and edge cases.
* Review AI-generated code, tests and documentation before including them in a change.
* Troubleshoot defects, address review feedback and keep technical documentation current.
* Support AWS deployments and CI/CD activities using established patterns, controls and runbooks.
* Collaborate with Platform, Quality Engineering, data, security and operations colleagues.
* Learn and apply software engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback.
* Develop proficiency in AI, cloud and software engineering technologies through practical project work.
* Contribute to reusable components and documentation.

  

**About You:**

* You must have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or equivalent practical experience.
* Up to 2 years of software engineering, data, machine-learning or relevant project experience.
* Working knowledge of Python, Git, APIs, automated testing and core software engineering practices.
* Familiarity with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy or scikit-learn.
* Foundational understanding of generative AI and machine learning concepts, including prompts, embeddings, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), model evaluation and document processing.
* Exposure to natural-language processing, document processing, machine-learning frameworks or AI application development.
* Exposure to cloud services, preferably AWS. Familiarity with Azure or another cloud provider is an advantage.
* Interest in AI testing approaches, evaluation methods and test harnesses.
* Strong learning mindset, analytical ability, communication skills and attention to detail.
Knowledge of financial services is helpful but not required.  

**AI-Native Engineering Expectations**

* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate learning, implementation, testing and documentation within team guardrails.
* Validate generated output for correctness, security, relevance and maintainability.
* Be able to explain why submitted code and tests exist and what behavior they protect.
* Apply established prompt, RAG and AI application test cases, datasets and harnesses with guidance.
* Escalate uncertain, sensitive or high-risk outputs for human review.
* Demonstrate responsible use of AI coding assistants and development tools.
* Seek guidance when generated outputs impact security, compliance, architectural decisions or business-critical functionality.
Continuously improve understanding of AI development patterns and quality practices.  

**Career Development Expectations**

* Demonstrate continuous growth in software engineering, cloud and AI technologies.
* Progressively take ownership of increasingly complex features with guidance.
Develop the skills required to independently deliver AI-enabled solutions.  

**Our Benefits**

Your well being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

jobs.title: Junior Web Developer
jobs.description:
**Must be enrolled in a post secondary educational institution.**

Art Vancouver is seeking a motivated Junior Web Developer & Automation Intern to support the migration and rebuild of our website on Wix, alongside back-end workflow automation setup. This is a hands-on role ideal for a student or recent graduate looking to gain real-world experience in web development, digital operations, and non-profit arts administration.

Responsibilities

**Website Migration & Development**

* Assist in transferring existing website content to a new Wix platform
* Rebuild and organize site pages, navigation, and layouts in Wix Editor or Wix Studio
* Ensure all content, images, links, and forms are accurately migrated and functional
* Optimize pages for mobile responsiveness and accessibility
* Conduct quality assurance testing across browsers and devices

**Back-End & Automation Setup**

* Set up and configure Wix back-end features including member areas, forms, and databases (Wix CMS / Wix Velo as needed)
* Build basic automations for tasks such as registration confirmations, contact form responses, and event notifications
* Connect third-party tools and integrations (e.g. email marketing, registration platforms)
* Document all workflows, automations, and site structure for handoff

**General Support**

* Attend team check-ins and provide progress updates
* Maintain organized file and asset libraries
* Support the marketing and events team with digital requests as capacity allows

Qualifications

**Required**

* Currently enrolled in or recently completed a diploma or degree in Web Development, Computer Science, Digital Marketing, or a related field
* Familiarity with Wix, WordPress, or similar CMS platforms
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Wix Velo (JavaScript-based development)
* Familiarity with automation tools (Zapier, Make, or similar)
* Interest in the arts, culture, or non-profit sector
* Experience with Google Workspace or project management tools

What You'll Gain

* Hands-on experience with a full website migration project from start to launch
* Exposure to digital operations in a non-profit arts organization
* A portfolio-ready project with real impact
* Mentorship from the Art Vancouver team
* A reference letter upon successful completion

Job Types: Full-time, Apprenticeship, Internship / Co-op, Seasonal

Pay: $18.25 per hour

Application question(s):

* Are you registered in a school at this time?

Experience:

* Web services: 1 year (preferred)

Work Location: In person
